decisions.issue: Preserve raw Issue and use product_family + Issue as key.
decisions.normalized_duplicates: Never split one normalized fingerprint across train/evaluation.
decisions.raw_data: Never delete duplicate rows from the raw dataset.
decisions.raw_product: Preserve original Product and add product_family.

deduplication.implication_for_temporal_split: Never split one normalized fingerprint across train and evaluation. Publish both operational all-text and novel-text purged metrics.

policy.collision_risk: MD5 collisions are theoretical but not impossible; confirm critical groups with a collision-safe follow-up.
policy.exact_text: MD5 plus raw text length inside DuckDB.
policy.is_repeated: True when the normalized group has more than one row.
policy.modeling_group_id: Use normalized fingerprint plus normalized length.
policy.normalized_text: Lowercase, trim, and collapse whitespace only.
policy.templates_policy: Near-duplicates beyond this normalization remain a later audit.
policy.unique_complaint_id: Integrity check only; it is not text deduplication.

next_stage_requirements: Review 2017 and August 2023 taxonomy regime boundaries.
Quantify credit_reporting concentration by year and narrative coverage.
Investigate 2025/2026 volume and process-integrity anomaly without automatic exclusion.
Choose a cut date and minimum class criteria explicitly in S2.
Construct group-aware temporal partitions using normalized fingerprints.
reasons: No temporal split cut date has been configured.
Minimum per-class row and year criteria are not both configured.
The 2017 and August 2023 form regimes require review before splitting.
Credit-reporting concentration and the 2025/2026 anomaly require review.
S1 does not select or seal a scientific temporal split.

limitations: The normalized fingerprint does not remove numbers or PII in S1.
Near-duplicate templates remain a later audit, not an automatic purge.
2026 is partial in this snapshot and may reflect process changes.
The June 2026 notice is a review signal, not an exclusion rule.
No model training or final temporal split selection occurs in S1.
